description: Every AppTweak endpoint in a local-first CLI — keyword rank fan-outs, competitor metadata diffs, and review mining that no MCP server can do.

novel_features.name: Cross-Country Keyword Rank Fan-Out
novel_features.description: Check keyword rankings across many countries in one command — no MCP tool or competitor offers multi-country fan-out.

novel_features.name: Competitor Metadata Diff
novel_features.description: Compare metadata between two app versions or two competitor apps to spot ASO experiments.

novel_features.name: Keyword Basket Tracker
novel_features.description: Sync and alert on ranking changes for a saved keyword basket across apps and countries.

novel_features.name: Review Sentiment Pipeline
novel_features.description: Aggregate review ratings by keyword term — find what topics drive 1-star vs 5-star reviews.

novel_features.name: Paid vs Organic Keyword Gap
novel_features.description: Find keywords a competitor bids on where your app doesn't rank organically — ASA opportunity map.

novel_features.name: Credits Monitor
novel_features.description: Check remaining API credits and burn rate before running expensive bulk queries.
